scope: Retain local complete-app archive metadata, not opaque app/model payloads.
limits: Archive is in owned local cache; no cloud asset, public release, fresh-machine app execution, GUI, microphone, quality, performance or signing/notarization gate is established.
Exact full app contains model bytes for later offline delivery; only metadata/hashes/scripts/logs are retained in Git.
Independent standard-library tar iteration checks all canonical sdk/ member names, uniqueness, modes, types, alias targets and regular-file lengths/digests without extraction.
Model-free archive construction uses3GiB start/1GiB running/256MiB reserve;5GiB neural admission remains unchanged.
